appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Digital Workplace looks and fits your workflow.
appearance.groupDescription: These preferences are saved to your account and follow you across devices.
appearance.providerGroupDescription: These provider operator preferences are stored only in this browser and never change a customer tenant's settings.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Adjust visual clarity and motion for a more comfortable experience.
accessibility.groupDescription: Changes take effect immediately across Digital Workplace.

language.title: Language & region
language.description: Choose the language used for navigation, actions, and messages.
language.groupDescription: Your choice is saved to your account and follows you across sessions.

home.title: Home workspace
home.description: Organize the apps and information shown on your personal home.
home.groupDescription: Open the home editor to arrange apps and widgets.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Manage channels, quiet hours, and per-app delivery rules.

managed.title: Managed settings
managed.description: Review organization-managed experience defaults and exception requests.
managed.notice: These values are managed by {{owner}}. If work requires a different value, request an exception with evidence and impact.
managed.groupDescription: Managed values keep the experience consistent across your workspace.

colorMode.title: Color mode
colorMode.description: Follow your system or choose a fixed light or dark appearance.

density.title: Interface density
density.description: Adjust spacing in operational controls and information lists.

highContrast.title: High contrast
highContrast.description: Increase boundaries and text contrast throughout the interface.

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Minimize nonessential transitions and interface movement.

underlineLinks.title: Always underline links
underlineLinks.description: Add a persistent visual cue so links do not rely on color alone.

reduceTransparency.title: Reduce transparency
reduceTransparency.description: Remove translucent backgrounds and backdrop effects for clearer boundaries.

language.title: Product language
language.description: Change the language used by Digital Workplace.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: Display dates and activity times in your preferred IANA time zone.

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.description: Choose a consistent date order for lists, details, and exports.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: Use your language default or choose a 12- or 24-hour clock.

firstDayOfWeek.title: First day of week
firstDayOfWeek.description: Set the week boundary used by calendars and date ranges.

numberFormat.title: Number format
numberFormat.description: Choose the grouping and decimal separators used for numeric values.

homeWorkspace.title: Apps and widgets
homeWorkspace.description: Choose what appears on your home workspace and how it is arranged.

policySource.title: Policy source
policySource.description: The tenant experience policy that supplies organization-managed defaults.

policyOwner.title: Policy owner
policyOwner.description: Contact this role when a managed setting needs to be reviewed.

personalPreferences.loadError: Your account preferences could not be loaded. Cached settings remain active, and changes are disabled until the service is available.
personalPreferences.saveError: Your personal preference could not be saved. The last confirmed settings have been restored.

exceptions.title: My exception requests
exceptions.description: Track managed-value requests and the accountable decision. Approval does not apply a value automatically; the policy owner completes a governed change.
exceptions.loadError: Exception request history could not be loaded.
exceptions.emptyDescription: You are currently using your organization's managed defaults.

dialog.title: Request a {{setting}} exception
dialog.description: Send the business purpose and impact to {{owner}}. Approval records authority for a governed change and does not alter the setting immediately.
dialog.requestedValueHelp: Enter the specific value required for the work.
dialog.justificationHelp: Describe the work and scope in at least 10 characters.
dialog.impactHelp: Describe the impact if denied and the expected users in at least 10 characters.

toasts.failed: The exception request operation could not be completed.

appearance.label: Appearance preview
appearance.title: Operational workspace
appearance.description: Theme and density changes are applied here and across the product immediately.

accessibility.label: Accessibility preview
accessibility.title: Clear status and actions
accessibility.description: Contrast, motion, transparency, and link cues update without reloading.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Review the identity information and access context used across your workspace.
profile.loadError: Your profile could not be loaded.

identity.title: Identity details
identity.description: Each value shows its system of record. Organization-managed identity fields are read only here.

governance.title: Profile data is governed by your organization
governance.description: Name, title, email, organization, and role changes must be made in the authoritative workforce or identity system. Profile visibility follows tenant directory permissions and is audited by the owning service.

provider.description: Review the provider identity and control-plane access context used for global operations.
provider.identityDescription: Provider identity fields are sourced from provider-operated identity systems and are not customer tenant profile data.
provider.governanceTitle: Provider identity data is centrally governed
provider.governanceDescription: Name, title, email, and provider role changes must be made in the provider identity service. No customer workforce or tenant profile is exposed here.

posture.title: Sign-in protection
posture.description: Current tenant authentication policy and identity provider readiness. Enrollment details are not inferred when the identity provider does not expose them.
posture.policyUnavailable: Sign-in policy is temporarily unavailable. Session management remains available below.
posture.ssoDetail: {{protocol}} identity provider is enabled for this tenant.
posture.ssoNotConfiguredDetail: A tenant administrator must configure and verify an enterprise identity provider.
posture.idpUnavailable: Identity provider readiness could not be verified.
posture.mfaDetail: This is the tenant requirement, not a claim about your enrollment status.

provider.postureDescription: Provider sign-in controls and browser sessions are kept separate from customer tenant authentication policy.
provider.policyBoundary: Customer tenant SSO and MFA policy is intentionally not loaded for a provider identity. Provider authentication controls are managed in the provider identity realm.

privileged.title: My privileged access
privileged.description: Activate approved, automatically expiring roles only when needed instead of keeping standing administrator access.
privileged.reauthenticationNotice: After activation or revocation, you will sign in again to receive a token with the current access set.
privileged.loadError: Privileged access information could not be loaded.
privileged.emptyTitle: No privileged roles are eligible for activation
privileged.emptyDescription: Ask your company administrator for an eligibility with a defined duration and scope.
privileged.activateDescription: Enter the least time and business justification. Policy may require approval or stronger authentication.
privileged.ticketHelp: Enter an approved ticket reference when the role policy requires one.
privileged.justificationHelp: Describe the task and required scope in at least 10 characters.
privileged.activatedReauthenticate: Temporary access is active. Signing in again with the current access set.
privileged.requestError: Privileged access could not be requested.
privileged.revokeDescription: Active access will be revoked immediately; a pending request will be cancelled.
privileged.revokedReauthenticate: Temporary access was revoked. Signing in again with baseline access.
privileged.revokeError: Privileged access could not be ended.

errors.load: Active sessions could not be loaded.

toasts.otherSessionsSignedOut: Other sessions have been signed out.
toasts.sessionSignedOut: The session has been signed out.
toasts.signOutError: The session could not be signed out.

dialog.othersDescription_one: This will sign out {{count}} other active session.
dialog.othersDescription_other: This will sign out {{count}} other active sessions.
dialog.currentDescription: You will be returned to the sign-in screen.
dialog.sessionDescription: This browser will need to sign in again.
